paite: Huan hiai ahi, akum sawm-le-nihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, huai kha ani khat ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
heading: Aigupta Kumpipa Ole Toh Tehpih Ahi
english: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Mihing tapa, Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh suunna la phuak inla, akiang ah, "Namte humpinelkai lun lai kibatpih; tuipi a olepi na bang zaw hi; na nak a tuite phuansak in, na khe in na toknin a, aluite uh na ninsak vekta.
english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, ‘You were likened to a young lion of the nations; yet you are as a monster in the seas. You broke out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.’”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: ka len in ka hon khuh ding a, mi tampi toh, ka len in nang ahon man ngeingei ding uh.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples. They will bring you up in my net.

paite: Gamlak ah ka hon nuse ding a, gamlak ah ka hon pai ding; tung a leng tengteng ka samkhawm ding a, na tung ah; nang in leitung pumpi gamsa ka taisak ding hi.
english: I will leave you on the land. I will cast you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you. I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.

paite: Tang chih ah na sa ka lui ding a; na luang in phaizangte ka dimsak ding.
english: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.

paite: Na tenna gam tang tan in, na sisan in ka sil ding a, phaizang chih leng nangmah in adim ding hi.
english: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.

paite: Ka hon chimihsak hun chiang in, van ka khuh in aksi ka mialsak ding a; meipi in nisa ka liahmang ding; huan kha in avakna asuah kei ding hi.
english: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon won’t give its light.

paite: Na tung ah van a vak tengteng ka mialsak ding a; na gam ah khomial ka lengsak ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi,” chi in.
english: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on your land,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Na theih louh gam a namte lak a na siatna ka tunsak hun chiang in mi tampite lungtang ka lungzingsak ding.
english: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.

paite: Ahi, mi tampi nangmah ah lamdang sa in ka bawl ding a, ama ua ka namsau ka leh hun chiang in nang ziak in akumpipate uh leng mulkimhuai asa un alau mahmah ding uh; na puk ni in michih in ahinna uh tan lau in alingling ding uhi.
english: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid for you, when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ngal a; Babulon kumpipa namsau na tung ah ahong tung dek hi.
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.

paite: Na mite ka puksak ding, galhat mite namsau in, namte lak a kihtakhuai pente ahi ua, ahihse ding uh. Aigupta mite thupina, amipite tengteng ahihmang ding uh.
english: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.

paite: Tui tampi gei gamsa teng ka hihmang ding a; mi khete'n angap ninta kei ding; gamsa khete'n leng angap nin sam kei ding hi.
english: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won’t trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.

paite: Huchi in tui ka chimsak ding a, ka luangsak ding, luite, sathau bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Aigupta gam ka hihsegawp ding a, ahauhna tengteng ah vuaktang in, asung a tengte ka phukmang hun in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ngei ding uh.
english: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that of which it was full, when I strike all those who dwell therein, then they will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Hiai akahla ding uh ahi; namte tanute'n hiai kah in Aigupta leh ami tengteng asuun ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sawm-le-nihna, huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Misite Khovel
english: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Aigupta mipite kah ekek inla, amah leh nam minthangtak tanu kokhuk a paisuk khinte toh lei nuainung lam ah paikhia in.
english: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.

paite: “Kilawmna ah kua akhup a? Paisuk inla zeksumlouhte lak ah lum in.
english: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.

paite: "Namsau a thahsate lak ah apuk ding ua, namsau kiang a piak ahi khin ua, amah leh amite tengteng kaimang un.
english: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes.

paite: Sheol a om galhatmi mahmahte'n amah leh apanpih mite ahoupih ding ua; apaisuk ua, alum nilouh uh, namsau a thah, zeksumlouhte.
english: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.

paite: "Huai ah Assuria leh aheute tengteng a-om ua; ahante uh amah kim ah a-om a; avek un thah, namsau a puk vek ahi uh.
english: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,

paite: Ahante uh kokhuk thukpen ah a-om a, ahan kim ah aheute a-om uh; avek ua thah, namsau a puk vek, mihing gam galmuangsak lou mite ahi uh.
english: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

paite: "Huai ah Elam leh ahan kim ah aheute a-om ua; avek ua, namsau a puk, lei nuainung a zeksum louh apaisuk ua, mihing gam galmuangsak lou mite, azahlakna uh kokhuk a paipih sukte ahi uhi.
english: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.

paite: Mithahte lak ah amah leh aheute lupna abawlsak ua, ahante amah kim ah a-om a; avek un zeksum louh, namsau a thah ahi ua; akihtakhuaina uh mihing gam gallauna ahi nak a; kokhuk a paisuktate toh azahlakna uh apua ua, mithahte lak ah a-omsak uhi.
english: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.

paite: "Huai ah Meshek leh Tubal, aheute uh toh a-om ua; ahante uh amau kim ah a-om a; avek un zeksum louh, namsau a thah ahi uh; akihtakhuaina un mihing gam ahihmang zel hi.
english: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

paite: Zeksum louh, mihat pukte, kidouna galvan toh Sheol a paisuktate, anamsau uh lukham a nei, aguhte uh tung a alum uh omte kiang ah alum kei uh; amau lah mihing gam a mihatte launa ahi.
english: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads. Their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

paite: "Nang zaw zeksumlouhte lak ah kitan lemlum in na om ding a, namsau a site kiang ah na lum ding hi.
english: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.

paite: "Huai ah Edom, akumpipate leh aheutute tengteng a-om ua; ahatna ua; namsau a thahte lak ah asial uh hi; zeksum louh, kokhuk a paisuksate kiang alum uhi.
english: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.

paite: "Huai ah mallam heutute, avek un, Sidon mi tengteng, thahte lak a paisuksate a-om ua, ahatna un mi agallausak nak a, azum ua, zeksum louh in namsau a thahte lak ah alum ua; kokhuk a paisuk khinte toh azahlak khawmta uhi.
english: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

paite: "Pharaoh in amaute amu ding a, amite tengteng a lungmuan loh ding, Pharaoh leh asepaihhon tengteng, namsau a thahte ngei leng, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Mihing gam ah gallauna alengsak a, zeksum louh, namsau a thahte lak ah alum ding uhi, Pharaoh leh ami tengteng ngei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi,” achi hi.
english: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.
